How to play
Choose two current supports, then replace the forward counterclockwise support chain between them with two segments through the new external site.
The elastic boundary must be strictly convex, enclose every observed site and use no more than the available support pins. Retired sites remain required interior points.
A reversed corner, cut-off site or excessive active support stock loses. Enclose three arrivals in each of three studies; Reset or Restart restores the supports.

Tap labeled native controls, or focus a control and use Enter/Space. Every process is turn-paced. Reset study restores the current construction; Restart returns to study one.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Choose two current supports, then replace the forward counterclockwise support chain between them with two segments through the new external site.
The elastic boundary must be strictly convex, enclose every observed site and use no more than the available support pins. Retired sites remain required interior points.
A reversed corner, cut-off site or excessive active support stock loses. Enclose three arrivals in each of three studies; Reset or Restart restores the supports.

Tap labeled native controls, or focus a control and use Enter/Space. Every process is turn-paced. Reset study restores the current construction; Restart returns to study one.

Endless review

How to play
Precoat a parent, split by the selected ratio, then finish both child interfaces. Splits preserve oil and coating but increase total interface area.
Every process action advances protection grace. Expired unprotected neighbors coalesce; dilution lowers the hydrated dispersed fraction and costs finite water stock.
Meet individual size, count and full coating requirements through two final rests. Phase inversion, stock exhaustion or failed inspections loses; clear three dispersions.

How to play
Each movable diagonal must have a convex two-triangle union. The opposite point must lie outside or on the first triangle’s circumcircle; a positive incircle determinant marks a violation.
A flip replaces both adjacent triangles with the other diagonal. Fixed seams, point geometry and planar triangle coverage remain intact.
Certify every free edge within the flip allowance. Spent flips or three failed certifications loses; clear three geometries, Reset or Restart to rebuild.

Choose two current supports, then replace the forward counterclockwise support chain between them with two segments through the new external site.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Precoat a parent, split by the selected ratio, then finish both child interfaces. Splits preserve oil and coating but increase total interface area.
Every process action, including a split, advances protection grace. Adjacent droplets coalesce when both have zero grace and either interface is incompletely coated; dilution lowers the hydrated dispersed fraction and costs finite water stock.
Meet individual size, count and full coating requirements through two final rests. Phase inversion, stock exhaustion or failed inspections loses; clear three dispersions.

Tap labeled native controls, or focus a control and use Enter/Space. Every process is turn-paced. Reset study restores the current construction; Restart returns to study one.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Choose two unpaired directed boundary sides, choose reversed or same-arrow identification, then Pair. Pair every side once.
Reversed gluing identifies start with partner end; same-arrow gluing identifies start with start. Vertex classes update by transitive identification.
Completed Euler characteristic is vertex classes minus paired edges plus one face. Meet orientability and vertex-class targets in three authored finite studies. Three failed certifications end the attempt.
Complete all three finite studies. Reset recovers the current attempt; Restart begins the campaign again with the displayed replay seed.

Labeled native buttons support touch, click, Tab and Enter/Space. Integer interval sliders also have visible step buttons; no keyboard-only gesture is required.

Endless review

The authored surface-classification curriculum is finite. A procedural stream needs varied polygonal cell complexes and nontrivial quotient/vertex constraints, not relabeling three side words.
